719:t_001:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It certainly contains feelings, too. But they oppose our existence... They are close to the force that seeks to vanish.」

719:t_001:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「To describe it in one phrase, a mass of curses would be appropriate.」

719:t_001:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It appears to be a prison confining the $$御使い$$ of Sorrow.」

719:t_001:16.en:
$$セツコ$$
「As proof, even though we're so close, the feelings coming from it are so faint they could disappear at any moment.」

719:t_001:17.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「So the other $$御使い$$s have sealed her power.」

719:t_001:18.en:
$$トビー$$
「But isn't that strange? They're vicious bastards who can even crush a galaxy, right?」

719:t_001:19.en:
$$トビー$$
「Then if there was a traitor among them, they could just execute her or something.」

719:t_001:20.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Do they go easy on their own...?」

719:t_001:21.en:
$$トライア$$
「For now, it certainly looks like Miss Sorrow is in there...!」

719:t_002:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then everyone in the mobile force, please launch.」

719:t_003:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「It looks like there's an $$御使い$$ on our side inside that crystal after all!」

719:t_003:1.en:
$$桂$$
「So we came to rescue a captive princess, and an evil dragon is welcoming us.」

719:t_004:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Welcome to the $$カオス・コスモス$$. Today $$テンプティ$$ will welcome you all.」

719:t_004:2.en:
$$万丈$$
「Thank you for the courteous welcome. Will you face us in the flesh?」

719:t_004:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course not! That's $$ドクトリン$$ and $$アドヴェント#pilot$$'s job.」

719:t_004:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$テンプティ$$ just has fun playing with dolls.」

719:t_005:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「What's going on?! I feel $$テンプティ$$'s presence from every $$エル・ミレニウム$$!」

719:t_005:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's simple. $$テンプティ$$ is projecting part of her consciousness into those children.」

719:t_005:3.en:
$$葵$$
「Are you saying you're remotely controlling every unit?!」

719:t_005:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's a little different from piloting... $$テンプティ$$'s consciousness has fused with those children.」

719:t_005:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「That's right. It's similar to your $$真化融合$$.」

719:t_005:8.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course. $$テンプティ$$ and the others are those who touched the universe's truth and know the essence of dimensional power...」

719:t_005:9.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Because we're the $$御使い$$s.」

719:t_005:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They've gone further down the path of $$シンカ$$...」

719:t_005:12.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No, no! We're not that conceited!」

719:t_005:13.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$テンプティ$$ and the others serve God... By God, I mean the Supreme God.」

719:t_005:14.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The Supreme God... So that's the source of their power...!」

719:t_005:15.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then shall we start our game of house, filled with despair?」

719:t_005:16.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「How do you feel now? Does it feel like someone poured ice water on you just as you were getting full of yourselves?」

719:t_005:17.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Shut up! We haven't lost yet!」

719:t_005:18.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Hahahahaha! I love that optimistic side of you!」

719:t_005:19.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Then do your best! $$テンプティ$$ will be cheering you on from the back!」

719:t_006:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「That woman never stops screwing around...!」

719:t_006:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「$$楽しみのテンプティ$$... Just as her name says, she spreads malice with innocent glee...!」

719:t_006:2.en:
$$甲児$$
「Then we'll just crush that malice!」

719:t_006:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, target the $$エル・ミレニウム$$s! They're the core of the enemy's forces!」

719:t_006:4.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「You say that, but even the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s battleships covered in faces are on the front lines!」

719:t_006:5.en:
$$シモン$$
「We'll just pierce through all of them! For our promise to the $$アンチスパイラル$$, too!」

719:t_007:1.en:
$$正太郎$$
「So now she'll come out herself...」

719:t_008:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「She still had that much fighting strength left!」

719:t_008:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're amazing! You defeated $$テンプティ$$'s dolls!」

719:t_008:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「The $$エル・ミレニウム$$s you controlled certainly were stronger than the ones before...!」

719:t_008:3.en:
$$赤木$$
「But they can't beat the bonds between us and our beloved machines, who've shared all our joys and hardships!」

719:t_008:5.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Has the shock of losing her trump card driven her mad...?!」

719:t_008:7.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You really are the best! You're the best cure for boredom I've had in 120 million years!」

719:t_008:9.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You! Are you going to destroy Earth and other planets like it's a game?!」

719:t_008:10.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Whatever the other three do, that's $$テンプティ$$'s role.」

719:t_008:11.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「For now, I'll crush you with numbers. I've got as many spare dolls as I want.」

719:t_009:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Fly, $$シュロウガ$$! Tear fate apart with your black wings!」

719:t_010:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「My $$エル・ミレニウム$$!」

719:t_010:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Your doll games are over, $$楽しみのテンプティ$$!」

719:t_011:0.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「The $$御使い$$s are eternal. You know doing this is pointless, don't you?」

719:t_011:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But I got to see your frustrated face, even if only for a moment.」

719:t_011:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I told you, $$テンプティ$$! Your doll games are over!」

719:t_011:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Eventually all of you will be embraced by these black wings of sin and fall into endless darkness!」

719:t_011:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$! Giving you eternity was a mistake! Next time we meet, I'll punish you!」

719:t_012:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Though I doubt your so-called punishment will truly make me suffer...」

719:t_012:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'll deal with you later.」

719:t_013:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As I thought, I can't break the barrier that easily.」

719:t_013:1.en:
$$シン$$
「What are you doing, $$アサキム$$?!」

719:t_013:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will take revenge on all the $$御使い$$s who bound me with the chains called eternity.」

719:t_013:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Like hell you will! We have business with the woman on that planet!」
